arStrings.szText: "Have you found a way to purge Astaroth's blood from the relics?"
Not yet. But Donan’s notes are helping. There were few things he loved more’n the sound of his own pen scratching parchment.
T’weren’t him that fashioned the Wayfinder, but a fellow named Elias. It turns out, Donan was asked to destroy the thing.
Lucky for us, he didn’t. Keep looking around. As long as you have its powers, you should be able to access the other blood relics.
